title: GTA VI Story: One Score Changes Everything
label: OFFICIAL STORY / GAMING NEWS
script: Here's how GTA Six's story begins! Jason and Lucia are chasing a better life in Leonida. But one easy score goes wrong. And suddenly, they're caught in a criminal conspiracy. Now, their only way out? Relying on each other to survive. That's Rockstar's official setup! So, Jason or Lucia first?
